Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear impact sustained while turning left at low speed,
reporting neck and low back pain without loss of consciousness. The mechanism and
force of the collision are consistent with the soft tissue strain described, and the
patient has no known prior complaints involving these regions. Conservative care was
initiated, comprising chiropractic manipulation, therapeutic exercise, and soft tissue
work, delivered across 39 visits. Over time the plan expanded, with additional
services added in successive months and visit frequency remaining high relative to
what is typically expected for a strain of this type. Cervical and lumbar imaging was
unremarkable, and physical examination findings are largely based on the patient's
reported pain levels, with objective neurological and range-of-motion testing within
normal limits. Billing review is ongoing for two similar charges recorded on the same
date. Current recommendation is to taper care toward home exercise and reassess
function at the next scheduled visit.
